daily.subject: {card} came up for you today
daily.preheader: The Veil turned one card while you slept.
daily.greeting: The Veil turned one card while you slept, {name}.
daily.greetingAnon: The Veil turned one card while you slept.
daily.footerNote: You receive this because you asked the Veil to speak daily.

cards.arcana-0: Something begins before you feel ready for it. That is the only way anything begins.
cards.arcana-1: Everything you need is already on the table. Today is about whether you reach for it.
cards.arcana-2: You already know. You are simply waiting for someone else to say it out loud.
cards.arcana-3: Tend the thing you have been growing. It is further along than you think.
cards.arcana-4: Structure is not the enemy of freedom today. It is the floor you stand on.
cards.arcana-5: An old rule is offered to you. Take what serves; leave the rest in the vault.
cards.arcana-6: A choice that looks like it is about someone else is really about what you value.
cards.arcana-7: Two forces pull against each other. You are not meant to pick one — you are meant to steer.
cards.arcana-8: The scales do not care what you intended. Today, weigh what you actually did.
cards.arcana-9: Step back far enough to hear yourself. The answer is quiet and will not shout over you.
cards.arcana-10: Something turns today without asking your permission. Ride it rather than argue.
cards.arcana-11: Force will not open this. Patience will — and it will look like weakness until it works.
cards.arcana-12: Nothing is moving because you are looking at it from the wrong angle. Hang there a while.
cards.arcana-13: Let the thing end. You have been carrying its corpse for a while now.
cards.arcana-14: Mix, don't choose. Today rewards the middle you have been calling a compromise.
cards.arcana-15: Look at what you say you cannot leave. The chain is looser than it looks.
cards.arcana-16: What falls today was already unsound. Better it goes now, while you can still watch it.
cards.arcana-17: A small clear hope survives. Do not test it too hard; just let it be there.
cards.arcana-18: Not everything will resolve today. Move slowly and do not trust the outlines.
cards.arcana-19: Something is simply good today. You are allowed to take it without inspecting it.
cards.arcana-20: An old chapter asks to be answered honestly. Answer it and you are free of it.
cards.arcana-21: A circle closes. Stand in it for a moment before you go looking for the next one.
cards.chalices-1: Feeling arrives before you have a name for it. Let it arrive anyway.
cards.chalices-2: Something meets you halfway today. Notice it — halfway is rarer than it sounds.
cards.chalices-3: Go where the others are. What you need is in a room with people in it.
cards.chalices-4: You are refusing an offer out of boredom. Look again at the fourth cup.
cards.chalices-5: Yes, something spilled. Two cups are still standing behind you, untouched.
cards.chalices-6: The past is kind today. Visit it, take what is warm, and come back.
cards.chalices-7: Too many options is its own kind of trap. Pick one and let the others dissolve.
cards.chalices-8: You are allowed to walk away from something good that has stopped being yours.
cards.chalices-9: Ask for what you actually want today. It is closer to granted than you assume.
cards.chalices-10: Look at what you already have. Today it is enough, and that is not a small thing.
cards.chalices-page: A soft, unguarded message wants to be sent. Send it before you edit it clever.
cards.chalices-knight: Follow the feeling — but check where it is walking before you follow it far.
cards.chalices-queen: Feel it fully and stay standing. Today you can do both.
cards.chalices-king: Hold the deep thing steadily. Others will borrow your calm before the day ends.
cards.swords-1: One clean thought cuts through the fog. Say it plainly, once.
cards.swords-2: You are refusing to look so you can keep not deciding. Take the blindfold off.
cards.swords-3: It hurt because it was true. The truth is still the useful part.
cards.swords-4: Rest is the work today. Nothing you force now will hold.
cards.swords-5: You can win this and lose something larger. Ask what the victory costs.
cards.swords-6: You are already leaving. Stop checking whether the shore behind you has changed.
cards.swords-7: Something is being taken quietly — by you or from you. Look at it directly.
cards.swords-8: You are not tied. You are surrounded, which is a different problem with an exit.
cards.swords-9: The night made it bigger than it is. Count what is actually true in daylight.
cards.swords-10: It is finished, and being finished is the mercy. Nothing worse is coming.
cards.swords-page: Ask the blunt question. You will be forgiven for it faster than for the silence.
cards.swords-knight: You are moving fast and may be aiming at the wrong thing. Slow enough to check.
cards.swords-queen: Say the honest thing without the blade. Both are available to you today.
cards.swords-king: Judge it on what is in front of you, not on what you wish were there.
cards.pentacles-1: A solid, unglamorous opportunity. Those are the ones that last.
cards.pentacles-2: You are juggling well. Do not add a third thing today.
cards.pentacles-3: Let someone else hold the other end. This one is not meant to be built alone.
cards.pentacles-4: Holding tighter is not the same as being safe. Loosen one finger.
cards.pentacles-5: Help exists and it is nearer than the cold suggests. Ask, out loud.
cards.pentacles-6: Give or receive today — but notice which one you find harder.
cards.pentacles-7: It is growing; it is just not growing at the speed you wanted. Leave it alone.
cards.pentacles-8: Do the plain repetitive work. Today, mastery is spelled boredom.
cards.pentacles-9: You built this yourself. Enjoy it without apologising for it.
cards.pentacles-10: Think past this week. What you set down today outlives the mood you set it in.
cards.pentacles-page: Begin the practical thing badly. Beginning badly still beats planning perfectly.
cards.pentacles-knight: Slow, dull, dependable progress. Do not mistake it for standing still.
cards.pentacles-queen: Take care of the body and the room first. The rest follows the floor plan.
cards.pentacles-king: You have more resource than you are counting. Spend some of it deliberately.
cards.wands-1: A spark, and a narrow window. Move while it is still warm.
cards.wands-2: You have the map and not the courage yet. The courage comes after the first step.
cards.wands-3: What you sent out is further along than you can see from here. Wait well.
cards.wands-4: Mark the thing. A small celebration is not a distraction from the work.
cards.wands-5: Friction, not war. Argue it out and something better comes from the noise.
cards.wands-6: Take the credit today. Deflecting it is not modesty, it is a habit.
cards.wands-7: Hold the position. You do not have to win, only to not step back.
cards.wands-8: Everything arrives at once today. Answer fast and keep it short.
cards.wands-9: Tired and still standing is its own kind of victory. One more day.
cards.wands-10: Put something down. Not everything you are carrying is actually yours.
cards.wands-page: Say yes to the thing you have no experience in. That is what the day is for.
cards.wands-knight: Go — but decide now what you will not set on fire on the way.
cards.wands-queen: Be warm and unmistakable today. Both at once, no dimming.
cards.wands-king: Point at the direction and go first. Others are waiting to be told it is allowed.
